seoTitle: How It Works | 4-Step Sourcing Process | Connect HF
seoDescription: Learn how Connect HF coordinates B2B product sourcing from Tamil Nadu: requirement intake, supplier matching, quotation review, and production liaison.

hero.title: A Transparent, 4-Stage Sourcing Coordination Lifecycle
hero.subtitle: From detailed engineering briefs to container dispatch, we structure buyer-manufacturer communication with realistic expectations.

steps.step1Desc: You submit detailed product specifications, target order volume, and destination requirements. We review technical viability.
steps.step2Desc: We identify and screen manufacturers within relevant Tamil Nadu industrial clusters, verifying capabilities and active machinery.
steps.step3Desc: Direct factory quotations and timeline estimates are gathered and organized. Sample runs are coordinated for your physical review.
steps.step4Desc: Once you contract directly with the chosen supplier, we assist in milestone tracking, pre-shipment inspections, and port dispatch.
